name: max-unlimited-violation
description: Asserts the correct Battlescribe behavior for constraints with max="-1" (which means unlimited).

rosters.description: Roster with 21 Goblins. The Goblin selection has min="20" and max="-1" (ad41-8936-7a56-1717). Since max="-1" means unlimited, there is no upper bound. The expected behavior is that the constraint is absent.
